snippet:

title: Map: Track measles outbreaks, cases and vaccination rates by state across the U.S.
snippet:
Measles, one of the most contagious viruses in the world, is regularly infecting people in the U.S. again.

Already in 2026 more than 2,300 cases have been counted, making 2026 the two year for measles infections in the U.S. since 2000.

NBC News is continuing to track confirmed measles cases across the United States, using Centers for Disease Control and Prevention data.

Measles case counts reached a 34-year high last year, and seven months into 2026, this year’s total is even higher. [...] Measles infection counts skyrocketed last year with 2,289 confirmed cases, which had been the most reported since 1991. This comes despite the virus being marked as being “eliminated” in the U.S. —a designation meaning it is no longer constantly circulating — in 2000. The U.S. is in danger of losing that status following a year of continuous spread of the disease.

Three people, including two young girls, died in the U.S. from measles last year. [...] The major outbreaks last year began with West Texas in February. In October, a measles outbreak occurred along the Utah and Arizona border. In all, the CDC recorded 48 measles outbreaks in 2025, up from 16 in 2024. So far in 2026, 35 measles outbreaks have been reported.

Childhood vaccination rates have been backsliding, leaving communities vulnerable to this deadly disease.

title: As measles outbreaks grow in the U.S., maps and charts show a record number of cases
snippet:
Watch CBS News

# As measles outbreaks grow in the U.S., maps and charts show a record number of cases

August 12, 2026 / 2:57 PM EDT
/ CBS News

So far in 2026, the U.S. has recorded the most measles cases in more than three decades as outbreaks spread in multiple states, Centers for Disease Control and Prevention data shows. [...] CDC data shows about 93% of kindergartners in the U.S. were vaccinated against measles during the 2021-2022 school year and only 92.7% in the 2023-2024 school year. This is down from 95.2% during the 2019-2020 school year — a critical threshold to keep people safe. Only 10 states hit that threshold.

"When more than 95% of people in a community are vaccinated, most people are protected through community immunity (herd immunity)," the CDC states. [...] Bar chart showing the number of measles cases by year, from 2000 to present.
Total reported measles cases in 2026 (Choropleth map)

Out of the 2,289 confirmed cases last year, more than 750 were connected to an outbreak in West Texas that led to the deaths of two children.

Prior to 2025, the highest number of confirmed cases in the U.S. in recent years was 1,274 in 2019, driven by outbreaks in New York, California and Washington state. Most years the total was much lower.

title: U.S. measles cases surpass last year's total: Tracker
snippet:
The U.S. measles case count for this year has surged past last year's total and now stands at 2,295 — a level that hasn't been seen in 35 years, according to a Johns Hopkins University tracker that compiles state and local health data.

Why it matters:It's the latest sign that the virus is rebounding in areas with low vaccine coverage, threatening the United States' measles elimination status, which is due to be reviewed in November. [...] Jurisdictions including South Carolina, Utah, Texas, Florida and Arizona have the most reported cases. 
   The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reported 2,260 confirmed cases in its last update%20were%20outbreak%2Dassociated.) on July 16. The agency said there were 34 new outbreaks reported this year.
   The last time measles cases were higher was in 1991, when the U.S. had 9,643 cases, according to CDC data. [...] The big picture: The majority of cases are in unvaccinated people. While overall measles vaccination rates are still relatively high, public health officials say they must remain above 95% to maintain herd immunity.

By the numbers:As of Tuesday, there were nine more cases than in all of 2025, per the Johns Hopkins U.S. measles tracker.
